questions.q: Which deeds are most beloved to Allah according to the opening of this lecture?
options: Those that are consistent even if small
Those that are many but only once

questions.q: Which fast is most virtuous after Ramadan?
questions.explain: Fasting Muharram is most virtuous after Ramadan, including Ashura.

questions.q: What does Allah's rebuke of the Prophet SAW in the revelation prove?
options: The Prophet's honesty, since he did not hide the verse
questions.explain: The Prophet SAW conveyed even the verse that rebuked him.

questions.q: What is the attitude toward parents of a different religion?
options: Do not obey in shirk but keep treating them well
questions.explain: Be good to your parents even if they differ in religion.

questions.q: What principle applies in all situations including the household?
options: No obedience to a creature in disobedience to the Creator
questions.explain: This principle applies in the household too.

questions.q: Why did Umar differentiate stipends for the earliest to embrace Islam?
options: Because they sacrificed early and were honoured
questions.explain: Those who sacrificed early were honoured.

questions.q: What is the effect of banning a message of truth?
options: It often raises zeal and attention to the message
questions.explain: A ban does not stop the truth.

questions.q: What is a safeguard against slurs against the Prophet SAW?
options: Start with the sirah and know his character
questions.explain: Knowing the Prophet's character is a safeguard.

questions.q: Whose hypocrisy should we worry about, following Umar's example?
questions.explain: Do not accuse others of hypocrisy; Umar worried about himself.

questions.q: Doing fewer things and focusing on quality goes against excessive productivity culture.
questions.explain: True. Reduce commitments, focus on quality.

questions.q: Enjoying provision means we may be heedless without self-reckoning.
questions.explain: False. The companions worried that worldly comforts would reduce reward; we enjoy provision but are not heedless.

questions.q: Displaying verses out of context is the same tactic as Quraysh diverting attention.
